results.description:
Know exactly what your motorcycle costs you—and never miss a service again.

MotoVault is the complete garage for riders who care about their bike as much as the ride. Track every expense, log every service, record every mile, and plan every trip—all in one beautifully designed app built for motorcycles, not cars.

--------------------------
WHY RIDERS LOVE MOTOVAULT
--------------------------

* EXPENSE TRACKING — Every fill-up, every part, every shop visit. See exactly what your bike costs you per mile, per month, per year. Built for riders who actually want to know.

* SERVICE TRACKING — Oil changes, chain adjustments, tire swaps, valve checks. Log every service and keep a complete maintenance history that boosts resale value.

* SMART REMINDERS — Never miss a service interval again. MotoVault tracks mileage and time, then nudges you before something becomes a problem.

* RIDE LOG — Auto-track every ride. Distance, time, route, fuel used. Build a beautiful logbook of every mile you've ever ridden.

* TRIP PLANNER — Plan your weekend ride or that big bucket-list tour. Save routes, set waypoints, and share with your group.

* AI MECHANIC — Hear a weird noise? Smell something off? Snap a photo and our AI diagnostic walks you through the most likely causes and fixes—in seconds. The first AI mechanic built specifically for motorcycles.

--------------------------
BUILT FOR REAL RIDERS
--------------------------

- Unlimited bikes—track every bike you own, free forever
- 12,000+ motorcycle models supported (NHTSA-backed catalog)
- Beautiful, dark-mode-first design
- Private and secure—your data is yours
- Optimized for solo riders AND group rides
- Designed in detail for US and European riders

--------------------------
WHO IT'S FOR
--------------------------

- Daily commuters who want to keep their bike in top shape
- Weekend warriors planning the next epic ride
- Adventure riders tracking long-distance tours
- Garage tinkerers who do their own maintenance
- New riders who want a smart mechanic in their pocket
- Anyone tired of car-first apps that treat motorcycles as an afterthought

--------------------------
MOTOVAULT PRO
--------------------------

Free forever includes unlimited bikes, full maintenance tracking, expense logging, ride recording, and 5 AI diagnostic scans per month. MotoVault Pro unlocks unlimited AI diagnostics, advanced rider analytics, unlimited GPX exports, and extended ride statistics — $4 per month or $36 per year.

Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Privacy Policy: https://motovault.app/privacy

Questions? Feedback? We read every email: hello@motovault.app

Two wheels. One app. Ride better.

results.description:
BikeFleet is a garage built for motorcycle owners who want to stay organized and in control of their bikes. Whether you ride one motorcycle or manage several, BikeFleet makes it simple to store every detail of your machine in one secure place.


You get an app focused on the essentials of motorcycle ownership. No more scattered papers, forgotten notes, or lost photos, everything about your bike is structured and easy to access, right in your pocket!


What you can do with BikeFleet today:


Add Motorcycle Specs
Record all the key details of your bike, including model, year, mileage, VIN, license plate, and registration date. Build a complete digital profile for each motorcycle you own.


Log Maintenance & Services
Track oil changes, tire replacements, inspections, and any other maintenance. Add the date, mileage, and type of service, plus optional notes to remember the details. Never lose track of your bike’s care.


Store Documents & Photos
Upload manuals, receipts, registration papers, and any other important documents. Attach photos of your motorcycle or service events to keep a clear history at your fingertips.


Organize Notes
Jot down anything related to your motorcycle: customization ideas, upcoming repairs, ride logs, or reminders. Keep all your notes linked to the right bike.


Manage Multiple Motorcycles
Whether you have one bike or a full collection, BikeFleet lets you add as many motorcycles as you want. Switch between them instantly and see their specs, notes, and records.


Why BikeFleet?


Owning a motorcycle is more than just riding, it’s about taking care of a machine that matters to you. But too often, important details get lost: receipts thrown in a drawer, maintenance history spread across papers, or service intervals forgotten.




BikeFleet solves that problem by giving you a digital garage where every motorcycle you own is organized and documented. By logging your maintenance and storing your documents, you keep your bike’s value high, increase buyer trust if you ever sell, and ride with peace of mind knowing you have everything under control.


Unlike traditional paper logs or scattered apps, BikeFleet brings all-in-one bike management to your smartphone. It’s designed specifically for motorcycle owners, simple, clean, and made for the way riders actually manage their machines.


Who is it for?


Riders who want to track maintenance and service history.
Collectors with multiple motorcycles to organize.
DIY mechanics who log their own repairs and upgrades.
Everyday commuters who want reminders and easy access to bike details.
Every bikers 



Download BikeFleet today and take control of your motorcycle ownership. One garage, every detail, always with you.

- Decreased possibility of route taking offramp only to take onramp again
- Fix for color picker being unresponsive when saving a new location by long-pressing on the map

- Fix for old, already reached, waypoints being reinstated after editing a route during navigation

results.description:
Looking for an all-in-one motorcycle app that can help you plan your next trip and ensure your safety on the road? Look no further than Detecht! Whether you're a experienced rider or just starting out, Detecht has got you covered. With a range of features designed specifically for motorcyclists, Detecht is the ultimate app to help you stay safe, plan & navigate your routes, and connect with other riders.

The #1 app for people who love riding.

Safety Comes First

One of the most important features of Detecht is its safety tools. With automatic crash detection, safety tracking, and hazard warnings, you can ride with confidence, knowing that Detecht is always looking out for you. Our Automatic Crash Detection system will alert your emergency contacts in the event of an accident, while Safety Tracking keeps you connected to your loved ones with real-time location sharing. Our Hazard Warnings system will notify you of any potential hazards along your route, so you can stay alert and avoid accidents.

Plan Your Next Adventure

With Detecht's Route Planning features, you can create and navigate the perfect trip with just a few taps. Whether you're looking for curvy routes or round trips, Detecht has got you covered. Our planning tool makes it easy to customize your trip based on your preferences with stops, waypoints, and more. You can also explore over 250,000 user tracked routes to find the one that's right for you. The app allows you to plan your route in advance and ride it with our turn-by-turn GPS navigation and voice guidance, so you can focus on enjoying the ride when you're on the road. 

Connect with Other Riders

Detecht's motorbike community is a great way to connect with other riders. Our Social Feed lets you find riding buddies, share your experiences, and stay up to date on the latest news and trends. Take part in the discussions, chat with fellow riders, share routes, and plan your next adventure together.

Other Handy Features

In addition to the safety, route planning, and community features, Detecht also offers other handy tools for motorcyclists. The app supports GPX file formats, making it easy to import and export routes, while the ride statistics feature lets you track your progress and see how far you've come. These tools are perfect for serious riders who want to keep track of their progress and see how they're improving over time.

In summary, Detecht is the ultimate mobile app for motorcyclists, offering a range of features that cater to the needs of all riders. Whether you're a seasoned rider or just starting out, Detecht is the app you need to take your riding to the next level.

Detecht premium is available as an optional upgrade with three different periods, 1 month, 6 months and 12 months. You can subscribe and pay through your App Store account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions by entering the user settings in your App Store account after the purchase.

Privacy policy: https://detechtapp.com/privacy-policy

Join a worldwide community of motorcycle enthusiasts with MOTOSPOT.

Plan Your Next Epic Ride

Discover exciting destinations and curated routes tailored for motorcycles. Easily locate points of interest like bike shops, parking, mechanics, scenic views, restaurants, hotels, and more. Build custom routes with turn-by-turn voice navigation - download maps to access offline.

Join The Community Anywhere

Accidents happen. With MOTOSPOT's SOS feature, quickly request assistance from fellow riders if you experience mechanical trouble or an emergency on the road.

Map and Real Time Ride: Track riders and pillions near you on the map, chat with them, and express your eagerness to ride. Share your experiences, make new friends and never ride alone.

Garage: Keep all the necessary information about your bike and its maintenance and receive service notifications right in the app.

Events: Keep up to date with all the motorcycle events nearby or create your own and invite people to attend.

Rides: Organize and join rides with your friends or other riders. Share your experiences, make new friends and never ride alone.

Groups + Chats: You can discover new friends or connect with your existing riding buddies and initiate a conversation using our chat feature within the moto app.

Routes + moto POI: Plan your routes and find everything you need in the area: motorcycle shops, mechanic stations, food places, hotels, and other POIs which are tested and checked by other motorcyclists.

S.O.S.: Just push the SOS button to receive help from nearby riders or inform them about the police post.

Rev up your riding life with the app built for bikers by bikers. 

Download MOTOSPOT now to connect with riders worldwide, organize unforgettable trips, and experience motorcycle freedom to the fullest.

Motonia is built for motorcyclists: map-centric navigation, live rider visibility with privacy controls, real-time voice chat, group rides, hazard and police alerts, and ride-focused stats tied to your account.

Navigation & maps
Plan and ride with map-centric guidance suited to real roads and riding context, with interactive 3D maps and 3D bike models.

Flock Mode
Ride around the map and see the location of the ALPR cameras around your area

Group rides & voice chat
Host a group ride with a simple code and ride together with everyone's live position on the map. Talk to your crew with built-in group voice chat, or use proximity voice to hear riders near you — fading naturally with distance. Mute, block, and report controls are always available.

Live riders
See nearby riders when you choose to participate, with visibility settings: all riders, friends only, or hidden.

Proximity Chat
Talk to nearby riders as they get closer to you on the map, they fade away as they travel further away 

Police & hazard alerts

Leaderboards
Compete on top speed, miles ridden, and XP — globally or with friends.

Tracker
A live speedometer, lean-angle gauge, and wheelie timer for the track.

Safety
Hazard and map data can be incomplete or delayed. Never use Motonia while moving. Stop in a safe place before interacting with the app.

Profile
Profile and garage features — add friends, view profiles, and track your bikes.

Membership
